name: The Whisperer

mechanics.name: Orb and Barb Volleys
mechanics.description: It throws three projectiles at a time, either blue magic orbs or grey ranged barbs. The pattern changes as its health drops.
mechanics.counterplay: Set your overhead before the first one lands and it blocks all three. Expect the pattern to shift at four fifths, half and a third health.

mechanics.name: Shadow Tentacles
mechanics.description: Four tentacles break the surface four tiles from you and close on the tile you were standing on. Early on they form an X, later a cross.
mechanics.counterplay: Move like a knight in chess: two tiles one way, then one tile across. That dodges every standard formation.

mechanics.name: Screech
mechanics.description: It teleports south and screeches three times. Columns rise from the water to block them, and each column can take a different amount of punishment before it breaks.
mechanics.counterplay: Hide behind the weakest column first and the strongest last. Step into the shadow realm briefly to see which is which.

mechanics.name: Shadow Realm
mechanics.description: Parts of the fight only exist in the shadow realm, reached with a blackstone fragment. Your sanity drains fast while you are in there and slowly comes back when you leave.
mechanics.counterplay: Go in only for the seeds, the screech and the siphon, and leave as soon as you are done.

mechanics.name: Summon Leeches
mechanics.description: It calls up leeches to feed on you while it keeps attacking.
mechanics.counterplay: Clear them before they stack up. Leaving them alive costs more than the time spent killing them.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED. Ids come from Jagex's own gameval names rather than guesses, but nothing here has been confirmed in a live fight. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). Npc ids 12204 through 12207 all carry the same five-part model set and standing animation 10230; the four are presumably the real-world and shadow-realm states, and all four are in npcIds because the boss transforms between them rather than respawning (docs/DECISIONS.md D17). The tentacle is a separate npc, 12208, and detects on npc-spawn. Animations are the NPC_WHISPERER_01_* set, all unambiguous gameval names. THE ATTACK ANIMATIONS ARE CURATED IN PART, NOT IN FULL: the cache names six ranged sequences (10235 through 10240) and six magic ones (10241 through 10246), and only the first three of each are curated. Six variants of one attack almost certainly correspond to the wiki's shifting volley patterns, and curating all twelve would add nothing to discovery, which fires once; the remaining six are listed here so the live pass can decide whether any deserves its own mechanic. Projectiles PROJ_WHISPERER_01_RANGED_01 2444, PROJ_WHISPERER_01_MAGIC_01 2445 and WHISPERER_SCREECH_PROJ 2471 are curated because each carries an explicit projectile prefix or suffix in Jagex's own name; PROJANIM_WHISPERER_EGG_01_LARVAE_01 2456 and the two GHOST_SPAWN ids 2457 and 2458 are also projanims but are not curated, because nothing establishes which mechanic they belong to. THE TENTACLE PREVIEW MAY NOT RENDER COLOUR-TRUE. Npc 12208 carries a one-pair recolour table (-110 to -31870) over model 49250, and SCHEMA.md's recolor-table rule says a widget cannot apply an npc's recolour table. One pair is unlikely to cover the whole mesh the way Vorkath's zombified spawn did, so this is a risk rather than a known problem, but it has not been measured with ModelColors. THE CORRUPTED SEEDS AND SOUL SIPHON ARE KNOWN MISSING MECHANICS. Both are named on the wiki as shadow-realm phases but neither has an animation that clearly matches; NPC_WHISPERER_01_TELEPORT_SUMMON_SOULS_01_* 10256 through 10259 is the likeliest home for the siphon and is deliberately uncurated rather than guessed at. THIS BOSS'S ANIMATIONS ARE SKELETAL, SO THE PREVIEW VALUES ARE AN ESTIMATE, NOT ARITHMETIC (docs/DECISIONS.md D36). The method is the one Doom of Mokhaiotl already shipped under: take the zoom from struct 4588, the Combat Achievements screen's own entry for this boss, which pins model 49222 at zoom 2100, and compute shiftY from the bind pose extents at that zoom. This is the one boss in the batch that needed no zoom raise and sits well inside the ceiling, at shiftY 21, because model 49222 is wide and flat rather than tall, measuring Y[-173..0] against the Leviathan's Y[-1129..42]. staticFallback is false on all five; whether each body animation reads has not been eyeballed in game, and for a skeletal boss that check matters more than usual. The collection log page is titled 'The Whisperer', matching 'name', article included.
